correctness.rationale: In K=F41[w]/(w^2-3), 3 is nonsquare and lambda=2+16w has order 1680 by direct prime-factor tests. For alpha satisfying alpha^41+alpha+lambda=0, Q=41^2 Frobenius gives alpha^(Q^j)=alpha+j(lambda-lambda^41), with nonzero shift 32w, hence 41 distinct conjugates and irreducible degree 41. Independent exact polynomial quotient exponentiation verified X^((1681^41-1)/83)=1 modulo X^41+X+lambda, so root order cannot be maximal. Independent distinct C++ enumeration of all 1681 coefficient pairs found 384 primitive constants and exactly 64 with this specified order-83 modular-power obstruction, matching the source census; this is exhaustive finite algebra, not heuristic sampling. Does NOT assert all nonprimitive constants counted.
residual_risks: Nonprimitivity count 64 is only for the chosen divisor 83, not a classification of all failure modes.
